title: MarketHelper (PFE)
description: Final-year engineering project with Markethings, in a team of six — turning their in-house natural-language engine for finding French companies into a conversational assistant for sales and marketing teams. Proof of concept of an augmented RAG pipeline: LLM-based extraction of search criteria, embedding-based mapping of activities to official NAF codes, and multi-turn dialogue to refine a search, integrated with their existing stack and beta MCP server. My part: the CI/CD pipeline — checks on every pull request, secret scanning, branch protection, CI-gated deployments and nightly end-to-end tests — and now application security: auditing the public chat API for abuse and cost risks, and designing server-side identity, rate limiting and professional sign-in.
